title: Wilmington Civic News & Policy Update
description: A manually authored news or policy update record for the Wilmington Civic Briefing app.

type.description: Content type. Affects how the card is labeled in the digest.

headline.description: Short headline shown on the digest card. Max 120 chars.

summary.description: One or two sentence summary shown on the digest card. Max 300 chars.

body.description: Full article text shown in the detail view.

why_it_matters.description: Plain-English explanation of why this update is relevant to residents. Max 300 chars.

published.description: ISO date the record was published (YYYY-MM-DD).

expires.description: ISO date after which this record should no longer display. Null means no expiry.

geography.description: Geographic scope. 'wilmington' = city only; 'delaware' = statewide; 'both' = statewide but directly relevant to Wilmington residents.

source_name.description: Display name of the original source (e.g. 'City of Wilmington', 'Delaware DHSS').

source_url.description: URL to the original source. Null if no public URL exists.

category_tags.description: Which app categories this update relates to. Used for cross-linking.

resource_tags.description: Freeform tags linking to specific resource records or topics (e.g. 'rental-assistance', 'SRAP', 'vouchers').

urgency.description: Urgency tier. Mirrors the resource schema urgency values.

verified.description: True once the information has been confirmed against the source.

active.description: False to suppress a record from display without deleting it.
